title: &aThe Twilight Forest
subtitle: A realm of endless dusk, and the boss order that unlocks it.

quests.title: Through the Pool
desc: Dig a &e2x2 pool of water&r in grass, ring it with flowers or other small plants, and throw a &ediamond&r in. Lightning strikes and the portal opens.
The Twilight Forest is dark and dangerous, and its regions unlock in order: beat a region's boss and the next region opens. Areas you haven't earned hurt you (blindness, hunger, fire).

quests.title: A Map of Twilight
desc: A &eMagic Map&r shows the Forest's biomes and marks boss structures. Make the focus from a raven feather and torchberries, then the map.
Optional, but it saves hours of wandering.

quests.title: Twilight Metals
desc: The Forest has its own materials. &eIronwood&r (from raw ironwood found in hollow trees and chests) and &eSteeleaf&r (from steeleaf plants) make sturdy early armour and tools.
Hollow hills hold ore and treasure, guarded by redcaps.

quests.title: I. The Naga
desc: In a walled &eNaga Courtyard&r coils a giant serpent. It charges in straight lines: sidestep, then hit it while it turns.
Its scales make Naga armour. Killing it opens the way to the Lich.

quests.title: II. The Twilight Lich
desc: Climb the &eLich Tower&r. The Lich hides behind a shield and shadow clones: hit the real one when its shield drops, and swat its fireballs back at it.
It drops the &eScepters&r (Twilight, Life Draining, Zombie, Fortification). Its death opens three paths: the swamp, the dark forest and the snow.

quests.title: III-a. The Minoshroom
desc: In the &eSwamp&r lies a Labyrinth. A Maze Map helps; minotaurs roam its halls. The &eMinoshroom&r at its heart charges like a bull.
It drops a Minotaur Axe and &eMeef Stroganoff&r. Eat the stroganoff: the Fire Swamp beyond needs it.

quests.title: IV-a. The Hydra
desc: In the burning &eFire Swamp&r, the three-headed &eHydra&r guards its lair. Hit its heads when they open to bite, and keep out of the fire.
Its &eFiery Blood&r makes the Fiery set. (This is Twilight's Hydra; Ice and Fire has another.)

quests.title: III-b. The Knight Phantoms
desc: In the &eDark Forest&r stands the Goblin Knight Stronghold. Its inner doors only open after you place a boss trophy on the &eTrophy Pedestal&r inside.
Six &eKnight Phantoms&r guard the deepest hall. Defeat them all for Knightmetal and the way to the Dark Tower.

quests.title: IV-b. The Ur-Ghast
desc: Climb the &eDark Tower&r (carminite builders, ghastlings, towerwood borers) to the Ur-Ghast's chamber. Kill ghasts near a &eGhast Trap&r to drag it down.
Its Fiery Tears join the Hydra's blood for Fiery gear.

quests.title: III-c. The Alpha Yeti
desc: In the &eSnowy Forest&r, a cave holds the &eAlpha Yeti&r. It throws ice and pounds the ground: watch for falling icicles.
Its fur makes Yeti armour, and its death opens the Glacier.

quests.title: IV-c. The Snow Queen
desc: Atop the &eAurora Palace&r on the Glacier, the &eSnow Queen&r shields herself with orbiting ice crystals and drops blizzards on you.
Frostbinders will feel at home. Everyone else: break the crystals, then strike while she's exposed.

quests.title: V. The Highlands Open
desc: With the Hydra, the Ur-Ghast and the Snow Queen all dead, the &eHighlands&r welcome you.
Troll caves wind beneath them, and giants walk in the clouds above.

quests.title: VI. The Lamp of Cinders
desc: Deep in the troll caves, a Troll Vault holds the &eLamp of Cinders&r. Its flame burns away the thorns that wall off the last region.
Bring it out alive.

quests.title: VII. The Final Plateau
desc: Burn through the Thornlands and climb to the &eFinal Plateau&r and its unfinished castle. The Forest has no final boss yet; reaching it is the victory.
Few walk this far into the dusk.

quests.title: The Uncrafting Table
desc: The &eUncrafting Table&r takes crafted items apart into their ingredients, for a cost in XP.
Optional, and very handy for recovering diamonds from old tools.

quests.title: The Questing Ram
desc: A big multicoloured ram wanders the Forest's clearings. Feed it one block of wool of every colour and it rewards you.
Optional, and a good excuse to raise sheep.
